reflection_rule: at most one, only if an unused send slot remains; never a 26th send
transport_rule: every possibly billable send including retransmission consumes one slot; unknown outcomes retained; stop for reconciliation
estimate_type: hard upper bound, not expected spend or provider bill
gpu_bound_basis: Astra 1800 and script 300 at 200 steps scaled by 600/200; conservative hard wall bound includes waiting and recording; not measured throughput
